description: This source file defines the TemplateEngine class, which provides methods for processing FreeMarker templates by loading them from classpath resources, applying models, and writing output to strings or files.

classes.name: TemplateEngine
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to process FreeMarker templates from classpath resources, and output results as strings or files.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TemplateEngine.

methods.name: loadClasspathTemplate
methods.description: Loads a FreeMarker template from the classpath, processes it with the provided model, and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: writeClasspathTemplate
methods.description: Processes a FreeMarker template from the classpath with the given model and writes the output to the specified file.

methods.name: processTemplate
methods.description: Internal method that loads a template by path and processes it with the provided model, writing output to the provided Writer.
